user.description: Pick your amphiro b1. It only shows up while the water is running.

confirm.description: Pairing code for {address}. The default is derived from the MAC address and works for most devices. Keep the water running while you submit, so the code can be checked against the live data.

error.invalid_code: A pairing code looks like ABCD1234, or digits only, e.g. 585.
error.wrong_code: This code doesn't decrypt the shower's data. Keep the water running and try again, or check the code.

abort.already_configured: This amphiro b1 is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No amphiro b1 found. Turn on the shower and try again.
